unit: 24 independent pair schedules; both seat assignments clustered together; shared schedules across all five profiles
analysis: Report every arm. 95% percentile cluster bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not simultaneous confidence or a formal deployment test. No stopping based on scores. No hidden selection of the best arm.
cost: Realized iterations and elapsed choose time per candidate game; also fixed-path arithmetic from observed count of non-forced post-preview decisions. Concurrent native timing is not browser latency.
scope: Local native current engine, weighted public catalog and current prior, no pondering; does not estimate human win rate or actual public browser strength.
null: 12 identical-profile games must have identical physical trajectories, ignoring timing; unchanged-budget setter must match unmodified fixed-agent choices and RNG state.
